service_unit:
[Unit]
Description=UWB TAG WiFi relay + PX4 MAVLink/ULog logger (ROS 2 Humble)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=thoa
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/home/thoa/drone_tools/python
Environment=LANG=C.UTF-8
# Optional launch arguments, e.g. LAUNCH_ARGS="ground_host:=192.168.1.20"
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/uwb-px4-logger
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /home/thoa/UP4000/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && exec ros2 launch uwb_px4_logger logger.launch.py $LAUNCH_ARGS'
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
# SIGINT lets both nodes close their files and stop the PX4 log stream.
KillSignal=SIGINT
# Signal only ros2 launch; it forwards SIGINT to both nodes once.
KillMode=mixed
# Read the USB streams promptly even when the computer is busy.
Nice=-5
TimeoutStopSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
